decisions.decision: Consensus of the Board that a sewer rate increase of 16% in FY25 is required to fund the budget and meet obligations to Fitchburg and Leominster; annual increases estimated at 3% thereafter.
decisions.quote: it was the consensus of the board that a rate increase of 16% in fy25 is required.

decisions.decision: Consensus that the connection fee should increase from $2,250 to $3,900 in FY25.
decisions.quote: it was the consensus that the connecɵon fee should increase from $2,250 to $3,900 in fy25.
